constraints.name: attempt_challenge_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, application_id, target_id, challenge_id) REFERENCES vulntrack_verification.challenges(workspace_id, application_id, target_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: challenge_consumption
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((attempts = 0) AND (consumed_at IS NULL)) OR ((attempts = 1) AND (consumed_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: challenge_expiry
constraints.definition: CHECK (((created_at < expires_at) AND (expires_at <= (created_at + '00:10:00'::interval)) AND (expires_at <= declaration_expires_at) AND (declaration_version <= created_at)))

constraints.name: challenge_member_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, issued_by) REFERENCES vulntrack.workspace_members(workspace_id, user_id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: challenge_no_automatic_verification
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((state = 'verified'::text) AND (verified_at IS NOT NULL) AND (evidence_expires_at IS NOT NULL) AND (result_code = 'REMOTE_VERIFIED'::text) AND (attempts = 1) AND (verified_at < evidence_expires_at) AND (evidence_expires_at <= declaration_expires_at)) OR ((state <> 'verified'::text) AND (verified_at IS NULL) AND (evidence_expires_at IS NULL))))

constraints.name: challenge_target_fk
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (workspace_id, application_id, target_id) REFERENCES vulntrack.application_targets(workspace_id, application_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack_verification.guard_attempt()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.outcome<>'in_progress'
        OR ROW(NEW.id,NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,NEW.target_id,NEW.challenge_id,
               NEW.actor_id,NEW.provenance,NEW.started_at,NEW.deadline_at)
        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.workspace_id,OLD.application_id,OLD.target_id,OLD.challenge_id,
               OLD.actor_id,OLD.provenance,OLD.started_at,OLD.deadline_at) THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'immutable verification evidence' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$

functions.name: guard_challenge
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vulntrack_verification.guard_challenge()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$ BEGIN
    IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR ROW(NEW.id,NEW.workspace_id,NEW.application_id,NEW.target_id,NEW.issued_by,
        NEW.request_key,NEW.method,NEW.purpose,NEW.origin,NEW.url_sha256,NEW.declaration_version,
        NEW.declaration_expires_at,NEW.proof_sha256,NEW.created_at,NEW.expires_at)
        IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.id,OLD.workspace_id,OLD.application_id,OLD.target_id,OLD.issued_by,
        OLD.request_key,OLD.method,OLD.purpose,OLD.origin,OLD.url_sha256,OLD.declaration_version,
        OLD.declaration_expires_at,OLD.proof_sha256,OLD.created_at,OLD.expires_at)
        OR NEW.version<>OLD.version+1 OR NEW.attempts<OLD.attempts
        OR NEW.state='verified' OR (OLD.state<>'pending' AND NEW.state<>'revoked') THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'verification transition denied' USING ERRCODE='23514';
    END IF;
    RETURN NEW;
END $function$
